rationale: Given the Chief’s emphasis on a narrow, text-and-structure holding and his role as assigner, Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to control scope and preserve a broad coalition, with Kagan the next most plausible author to supply an administrable statutory reading. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters (miscarriage-of-justice/Suspension Clause framing) and from one or more conservatives to underscore original-meaning limits or to cabin the holding to avoid foreclosing true “structural impossibility” cases.
